 who are you

 what are you going to do 
 As a Production Operator, you ensure that all machines run at optimal performance so production stays on schedule and meets the highest quality standards. Your day starts with checking the machines and setting the correct parameters. This requires precision, as a well-configured process results in fewer disruptions and a smoother workflow. 
Once production is running, you remain alert. If something isn't running perfectly, such as a machine malfunction or disruption, you know exactly what to do. You solve minor technical issues independently, while larger challenges are handled together with the technical department. You also perform regular checks to ensure everything functions properly and products meet quality standards. 
As a Production Operator, you work closely with the warehouse team, who supply the raw materials. You transport materials using a forklift and place bags of raw materials onto conveyor belts, hang empty big bags, and ensure the process continues without interruption. You're not afraid of physical work, as hands-on tasks are part of the role.
